## Architectural Invariants Check
- [ ] **Zero Accounts:** This change introduces no authentication, cloud profiles, or sign-in requirements.
- [ ] **Zero Telemetry:** No analytics, tracking, or advertising SDKs are added.
- [ ] **Offline Resilience:** All modified features function properly without an active network connection.
- [ ] **Deterministic Correctness:** Prayer time or Qibla bearing calculations remain verified and accurate.
